t: Jekyll's Antifragile Blueprint: Nix Flakes, MathJax, and the Liquid Template Imperative
s: Addresses the SSG speed vs. skill trade-off (Jekyll/Liquid Templates for Shopify SEO vs. Go/Hugo). Introduces a Nix Flake for an antifragile, reproducible Jekyll environment, auto-resolving Ruby dependency hell, native gem issues, and automating server startup with robust health checks.
sub: Jekyll Liquid Templates vs. Go/Hugo SSG speed-skill trade-off
Antifragile Nix Flake for reproducible Jekyll dev environments
Automated Ruby dependency hell resolution & native gem rebuilding
Jekyll server auto-startup and environment health checks in `nix develop`
